crossRefs.note: King David longed to go out to Absalom; for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate, and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son…
The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people; for the people heard it said that day, “The king…
The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”
Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
